Unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
Unsubscribe.description: Confirm that you no longer want to receive these messages.
Unsubscribe.alreadyBody: This address is already removed. No further messages will be sent.
Unsubscribe.doneBody: We've removed this address. You won't receive further messages.
Unsubscribe.invalidBody: This unsubscribe link is invalid or has expired. If you keep receiving messages, contact the sender.
Unsubscribe.errorBody: This link may have expired. Try the unsubscribe link in a more recent message, or reply to the sender to be removed.
